description: This file provides a set of shell commands and scripts for managing iptables rules, specifically adding, verifying, and cleaning up rate-limit rules for ICMP echo-request packets. It includes alias creation, rule insertion, verification, and cleanup procedures with commands that normalize and process output.
calls: iptables -I INPUT 1 -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
iptables -D INPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
